text:
maria g: Final reminder  need sign-offs by EOD today for the Q2 pricing A/B. Key open: refund cap number, grandfather cutoff date, and canary size. If we don't lock, we'll slip launch a week.

kevin t: Finance proposes cap = net increase rounded up to nearest $1. Samir prefers per-invoice cap = net increase but flagged edge cases for zero-dollar invoices.

samir: Also want to ensure we exclude partner coupons from refund calc. If a coupon reduced charge to $0, no refund kicks in.

jess l: Legal approved the comms with minor phrasing edits. They also need the opt-out API audit log retained for 2 years.

accounting-bot: Flag: 12 outstanding invoices in the window have multi-line discounts. Confirm discount exclusion logic before runbook starts.

nora: Ops will tag the canary customers tonight and run a dry run script that prints anticipated adjustments to a CSV. Will post results in this thread.

maria g: OK locking decisions: grandfather cutoff = accounts created before 2026-01-01 get 60 days; canary = 5% stratified; refund cap = net increase per invoice. Everyone please ack.

kevin t: ack. prepping migration PR.

samir: ack. monitoring playbook ready.

jess l: ack. legal saved the email template to the drive.

accounting-bot: automation job scheduled; will post reconciliation logs after dry run.

maria g: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after dry-run.
